newsitem.title: DUBAI: Death sentence endorsed against Dubai killer.
newsitem.headline: Death sentence endorsed against Dubai killer.

text.p: Dubai's Crown Prince Sheikh Mohammad bin Rashid al-Maktoum has endorsed a death sentence against a United Arab Emirates (UAE) man for kidnapping, raping and killing a seven-year-old girl, newspapers said on Thursday.
The newspapers quoted officials as saying the public prosecutor will now coordinate with the police on carrying out the sentence against Khalid Mohammad Moussaji.
Some said the sentence would be carried out next week.
The court had sentenced Moussaji's brother-in-law to life imprisonment for assisting and keeping silent about the 1995 kidnap and murder of the girl, identified only as Amina.
The UAE has enforced the death sentence for crimes such as rape, murder and drug smuggling. Executions are usually carried out by firing squad.
